theme: Last day ashore before a week at sea.
greeting: You're in Dubrovnik with the boat waiting — the Nautilus charter boards around 5, and the week ahead goes quiet on connectivity. Clear the shore-side logistics before you cast off.

needsAttention.title: Confirm the boarding meet-up with the instructor
needsAttention.detail: You board around 5 PM today and still need the exact meeting time and place — the outreach task has been open since Sep 5. Settle it while you're on shore, and pin down the Sep 19 return transfer to the airport now too.

needsAttention.title: Lock the Cavtat Sept 19 transfers and checkout
needsAttention.detail: The hotel is booked, but the Komolac→Cavtat transfer, early-afternoon bag hold, and pre-dawn Sep 20 checkout all have to be arranged from dry land — charter connectivity is poor. The hotel's free-cancellation window also lapses Sep 15 while you're at sea.

needsAttention.title: Book the TPA rental car, Sep 20–Oct 5
needsAttention.detail: This is now certain, not a hedge — full-size SUV, land TPA Sun Sep 20 at 3:55 PM. Do it before the week offline so a car is waiting rather than a walk-up rate on a jet-lagged Sunday.

needsAttention.title: Provision in Dubrovnik before the boat
needsAttention.detail: Pick up local cash (~€200 for incidentals), snacks, drinks for the week, and any gluten-free non-perishables — all harder to sort once underway. Studenac, Tommy, or Konzum downtown.

flagged.title: New VP, Government Affairs roles
flagged.detail: LinkedIn flagged openings like the NYT VP, Government Affairs post — a job alert, nothing to answer.

inbox.noise: The rest is retail and reading — Schoolhouse, Folio Society, NYT Cooking, Slightly Foxed.

recipe.title: Duck breasts with apples & caraway
recipe.why: An autumn dish that leans on what the season brings to the table.

tasks.title: Close the St Pete landing-gap lodging (Sep 20–22) and confirm the Sep 27–Oct 5 Airbnb converted from pending

acts.line: A last stretch ashore in Dubrovnik — cash, provisions, and the final logistics calls before the boat.
Confirm the meeting point with the instructor, then board the charter around 5.
First night aboard, and connectivity drops for the week — anything owed on land needs settling first.
